headline: Chilli Beans Files for Extrajudicial Reorganization for R$340M Debt
summary: Eyewear and watch retailer Chilli Beans has requested extrajudicial reorganization to renegotiate R$340 million in bank debt. The restructuring plan includes up to R$50 million in new funding from creditors.
why: Extrajudicial debt restructuring allows distressed retail companies to negotiate obligations directly with creditors under legal oversight while attempting to secure operational continuity.
